hero.caption:
LONDON- UK- 5th May 2023. HM King Charles III accompanied by other members of the royal family hosts a reception at Buckingham Palace for the Heads of State and other visiting dignitaries who are due to attend tomorrows Coronation.

Photo by Ian Jones.

images.caption: Ceremonial shovels placed next to a plaque to mark the oak tree planted at a ceremonial tree planting earlier that day at Coronation Park. The ceremonial tree planting was part of the City of Toronto's local commemorations for King Charles III's coronation, which also included the raising of the Canadian coronation flag and an offering of tobacco from the Mississaugas First Nations at Coronation Park.

images.caption:
Tweet Text: 
His Majesty King Charles III was presented with the Honours of Scotland today at St Giles’ Cathedral. 
This followed a People’s Procession and Royal Procession on the Royal Mile. 

A 21-Gun Salute and flypast by the Red Arrows also took place.
